In his wisdom Team Manager John Jeffery had a word with Cardiff 400m star Jamie Baulch who seemed to be going like a train every time out. "Look Jamie, we don't want the Beagles to win this race ... do us a favour ... take it for Cardiff".

…en again, they didn't exactly hang about in the 400m where this time our Dave Nolan got shunted into second by Welshman Jamie Baulch. Sale's Kevin McKay used the craft gained over years of international competition to get ahead of Tom Lerwill in the 'eight' but we were piling up the points steadily…
Darrell Maynard took advantage of Jamie Baulch going for a 100/200 double and picked up a nice little win over one lap for a change. The real 400m fireworks were at the "Surreys", however.
